_comment: The allow-list data. One allow-list per artefact kind (agents, skills, commands) for omp's documented keys (`omp://task-agent-discovery.md`, `omp://skills.md`). Enforced by frontmatter-check.mjs: unknown keys are rejected, required keys are enforced, and `forbidden` catches a key that reads as configuration but silently reroutes a member's tier, tree, or dispatch.

forbidden.thinking-level: the level rides on model's `@<role>:<level>` suffix — one spelling only
forbidden.thinking: the level rides on model's `@<role>:<level>` suffix — one spelling only
forbidden.effort: retired Claude Code key — silently ignored by omp
forbidden.prewalk: silent mid-run model hand-off — a tier degradation the fleet forbids
forbidden.advisor: silent mid-run model hand-off — a tier degradation the fleet forbids
forbidden.isolation: members never use harness isolation: omp builds the workspace outside the claimed worktree and patch-applies into the controller's checkout

model.message: must be a fleet tier route `@slow|@task|@smol` with an explicit `:<level>` suffix

name.message: must be fleet--prefixed with no ':' — omp's agent registry is bare-name/unnamespaced, so the prefix is the only collision guard

forbidden.hooks: no documented meaning for fleet skill frontmatter
forbidden.shell: no documented meaning for fleet skill frontmatter
forbidden.alwaysApply: omp auto-injection — fleet skills are invoked, never injected

forbidden.hooks: no documented meaning for fleet skill frontmatter
forbidden.shell: no documented meaning for fleet skill frontmatter
forbidden.alwaysApply: omp auto-injection — fleet skills are invoked, never injected
forbidden.globs: skills-only (omp file-scoping) — no defined meaning for a flat command file
forbidden.paths: skills-only — no defined meaning for a flat command file
